name: @pipeworx/mcp-quotable

tools.name: random_quote
tools.description: Get a random quote, optionally filtered by tag (e.g., "Wisdom", "Motivational") or author slug. Returns quote text, author, and tags. Tags come from a fixed list — call list_tags to see it.

limit.description: Number of quotes to return (1–10, default 1)

tags.description: Filter by tag(s) from list_tags. Comma for AND, pipe for OR, e.g. "Wisdom" or "Humorous|Science". Case is normalised for you.

tools.name: search_quotes
tools.description: Search quotes by keyword or phrase. Returns matching quotes with author names and topic tags.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for in quote content

limit.description: Number of results per page (1–100, default 20; rounded up to 10/25/50/100)

tools.name: get_authors
tools.description: Look up an author by slug (e.g., "albert-einstein"). Returns bio, description, and total quote count. Without a slug, returns a page of the author list — the upstream list is unordered and cannot be searched, so prefer passing a slug.

slug.description: Author slug(s) to look up, e.g. "albert-einstein". Supports pipe-separated values for multiple authors.

limit.description: Authors per page when browsing without a slug (1–100, default 20; rounded up to 10/25/50/100)

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: Browse all available quote tags sorted by popularity. Use returned tags with random_quote to filter by topic.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-quotable forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the quotable pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
